I have enough context now. Here's the full file list and required changes for a "Rest at the Inn" feature (gold → full HP):

## Worker

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `worker/src/types/index.ts` | Add `RestBody { sessionId, characterId, cost? }` interface (mirrors `ShopTransactionBody`). Optionally a `REST_COST` constant near `XP_THRESHOLDS`. |
| `worker/src/routes/shop.ts` (or a new `routes/rest.ts`) | New endpoint, e.g. `POST /api/shop/rest` or `POST /api/rest`: load character via `getCharacter`, check `character.gold >= cost`, then `updateCharacter(db, id, { gold: character.gold - cost, hp: character.max_hp })`. Return `{ success, cost, hp, updatedGold }`. |
| `worker/src/index.ts` | If using a new route file, add `import { restRoutes } from './routes/rest.js'` and mount `app.route('/api/rest', restRoutes)`. Not needed if added inside `shopRoutes`. |
| `worker/src/services/character.ts` | No new function strictly needed — `updateCharacter` already whitelists `hp`/`gold`. Only touch if you want a dedicated `restAtInn()` helper. |
| `worker/src/routes/shop.md` (or new `routes/rest.md`) | Document the new endpoint, request/response shape, gold/HP rule. |
| `worker/src/index.md` | Add the new mount row if a separate route file is used. |

## Frontend

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `frontend/src/app/services/game-api.service.ts` | Add `restAtInn(sessionId, characterId)` → `POST /api/shop/rest` (or `/api/rest`). |
| `frontend/src/app/models/game.models.ts` | Add `RestResponse { success, cost, hp, updatedGold }` (or reuse an existing shape). |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.ts` | Add `restAtInn()` calling the service, then `characterState.setCharacter({...character, hp, gold: updatedGold})`. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.html` | Add a "Rest at the Inn" button (left sidebar, near Inventory/level-up), likely disabled when `inCombat` or gold < cost. |
| `frontend/src/app/services/character-state.service.ts` | No new method needed; existing `setCharacter` covers it. |
| Doc files: `game-api.service.md`, `game.models.md`, `game-console.component.md` | Update method tables / flow / connections to mention rest-at-inn. |
| `PRD.md` §4.4 (Inventory & Economy) | Document the new rest mechanic and gold cost rule, since it's a new game economy feature. |
| `code.md` | Add entry if a new `routes/rest.md` doc is created. |

No existing code/docs mention an inn concept, so this is a net-new feature across both route layer and UI.
